title: How /settings ate the JSON config (and what stayed in code)
focus: A walk through the new Appearance, Input, Behavior, Providers, MCP, and Advanced tabs, why the wizard landing page and mode-specific providers were reshaped, how the in-app agents.config.json editor edits strings with the cursor inside the quotes and saves atomically, and what the NANOCODER_* env vars and the theme-aware StyledSelectInput fix look like in practice.
